name: demandflow-scheduler
description: DemandFlow Scheduler - Meeting Calendar Booking & Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
